summary_en: This phase II study tests maintenance treatment with durvalumab, with or without saruparib, ceralasertib, or monalizumab, chosen by biomarker tests, for extensive stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC). Maintenance durvalumab is given by IV over 60 minutes on day 1 of each 28-day cycle, and some arms add saruparib or ceralasertib by mouth or monalizumab by IV, repeating until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is phase II.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa el tratamiento de mantenimiento con durvalumab, con o sin saruparib, ceralasertib o monalizumab, seleccionado mediante pruebas de biomarcadores, para el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa (ES-SCLC). El durvalumab de mantenimiento se administra por vía intravenosa durante 60 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y algunos brazos añaden saruparib o ceralasertib por vía oral o monalizumab por vía intravenosa, repitiéndose hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Extensive stage small cell lung cancer, not yet treated or after 1 to 3 cycles of platinum and etoposide
Zubrod performance status 0 to 2 within 28 days before registration
Tumor subtype A or N with SLFN11 positive, or subtype P, or subtype I, depending on study arm
Able to safely receive platinum, etoposide, and durvalumab
not_for: Prior or current cancer that the treating doctor feels could interfere with study assessment
History of limited stage small cell lung cancer
Anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 treatment for SCLC other than durvalumab in frontline therapy
Unresolved toxicity grade 2 or higher from prior anticancer therapy, except alopecia and vitiligo
cancer_types: extensive stage small cell lung cancer
